designs.description: Clean lines, organic curves, and bold graphic elements from the 1950s-60s design era. Think Eames, Saul Bass, and Herb Lubalin. Geometric yet warm, structured yet playful.
Dark terminal aesthetic with cyan accents, monospace git-log timeline, dual tech/trek theming.
Strict 12-column grid, neo-grotesque Inter flush-left, hairline rules, zero radius, single signal-red accent.
